jobs.description:
Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:

• Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.
• Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.
• Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.
• Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.
• Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:

• Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.
• Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.
• Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.

Our client is a large Belgian organization with an extensive and business-critical IT environment. Within the infrastructure department, work is being done on various strategic programs concerning hybrid cloud, middleware, integration platforms, networking, and cybersecurity.To further structure multiple infrastructure projects and interdependencies, they are seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure Project Manager who takes ownership of planning, stakeholders, and delivery within the domains of AppStack, Network Security, and Networking.
Jobomschrijving
Here, you assume end-to-end management of multiple complex infrastructure projects within a hybrid enterprise environment.You coordinate projects related to middleware, integration, automation, networking, and network security, ensuring that technical teams and vendors remain aligned. You translate the various project lines into concrete plans, milestones, and deliverables, and closely monitor these using tools including MS Project and Jira.You guide technical teams during implementations, migrations, and infrastructure changes, while monitoring schedules, scope, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.You organize alignment and synchronization meetings, maintain coherence between different initiatives, and ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and management.Additionally, you oversee governance, documentation, compliance, and security requirements.

•  5y experience as Project Manager in IT-infra
• You are strong in stakeholder management and diplomacy
• Broad technical knowledge of infrastructure, cloud, middleware, integration, and security 
• Trilingual environment (English, Dutch & French): you should at least understand (not speak) them at a basic level and master one

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

A background in a law firm or consultancy, or a specific HR degree, is welcome but not required.

jobs.occupation: Budget Analyst at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Budget Analyst to join the Federal Aviation Administration.

Jobomschrijving

The job holder maintains budgets for all FAA lines of business in Brussels and FAA Representative offices located in Paris, Abu Dhabi, Dakar, Warsaw, and London. The budget management function includes expenditure forecasting, multi-year budget estimation, yearly travel budget development, expenditure tracking including travel burn rates, budget reconciliation, approval of payments, and submission of quarterly and close-out reports.

EDUCATION (multiple options): 2 years of University studies in any field or university degree in finance, accounting, business administration

EXPERIENCE: 2-5 years in finance, accounting, or business administration.

LANGUAGE: Fluency in English, French and Dutch.

Responsibilities

• Analyze and define security requirements to support organizational projects.
• Configure, support, and maintain security tools to ensure continuous protection.
• Manage identity components, user accounts, and complex provisioning processes.
• Implement and maintain advanced access management components and infrastructure.
• Monitor security systems to improve observability and defend against unauthorized access.
• Provide expert technical advice on OAuth and OpenID Connect protocols.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in security engineering or a similar technical capacity.
• 5+ years in Security and identity focusing on IAM, Active Directory, and Open LDAP.
• 5+ years of experience with OAuth and OpenID Connect authentication protocols.
• 3+ years working within SSDLC, RUP, and Agile methodologies.
• You possess practical scripting knowledge in Linux and Windows environments.
• You bring a solid understanding of application firewalls and web services security.
• You're proactive, solution-oriented, and a clear communicator.
• You are fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Previous professional experience in network security.
• Knowledge of web services within Auth0.
• Familiarity with Okta or SailPoint.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment

• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: ICT Talents - ERP Consultant (Oracle Fusion Cloud)
jobs.description:
For an international trading and distribution organisation, we are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Consultant to technically optimise the existing ERP environment and improve the efficiency of Finance and Operations.

Since the migration to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, many processes are still handled manually, with a lack of reporting and visibility. Your mission? To implement concrete improvements, reduce repetitive tasks and provide the business with the insights and tools it needs.
Job description

As an ERP Consultant, you will work closely with the heads of Finance and Operations. You will analyse existing processes, identify quick wins and translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Your responsibilities

• Reporting: Developing reports, dashboards, views and worklists, potentially in combination with Power BI.

• Automation: Implementing bulk uploads, streamlining transaction processing and reducing manual tasks.

• ERP optimisation: Analysing and improving existing processes within the ERP environment, with a focus on order-to-cash and procure-to-pay.

• Integrations: Optimising data flows and connections with external systems, such as EDI and Excel-based processes.

• Stakeholder management: Coordinating with Finance, Operations and the international IT team, while critically assessing and challenging potential solutions.

• Knowledge transfer: Documenting the implemented solutions to ensure the internal team can maintain them independently after the project.

We are looking for a technically strong, analytical and hands-on consultant who can quickly identify opportunities and deliver pragmatic solutions.

You have:

• Relevant experience with ERP implementations

• Experience with reporting, dashboards, views and worklists

• Good knowledge of Power BI and experience with EDI integrations

• Knowledge of bulk uploads, mass transactions and ERP process optimisation

• An understanding of order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes

• Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is a strong asset, but not an absolute requirement

• A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to work within existing system limitations

• Strong communication skills and a good command of English

• Knowledge of Dutch is not required, but is considered a strong asset

• Experience with Azure DevOps is a plus

Purpose and Mission

Organize and manage all commercial activity related to offshore operations. Create opportunities and secure orders to ensure the business meets its commercial objectives in line with the profit plan and agreed objectives and strategies.
 

Key Activities and Responsibilities
 

1. Identify concrete market potential, emerging trends, and industry shifts, including targeted qualification of key (lead) accounts within defined Single Point Mooring (SPM) applications. 
2. Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships between the organization and (potential) customers. 
3. Maintain and build worldwide strong network with agents. 
4. Negotiate effectively within commercial proposals to finalize sales agreements, ensuring acceptable deliverables and realistic timelines while balancing strict customer requirements with mutual commercial interests. 
5. Increase annual revenue from existing accounts by offering new products and services, identifying market opportunities and developing these into commercial solutions, and continuously evaluating the existing product range in line with 
6. Contribute to gathering relevant market intelligence by analyzing competitor products and customer feedback, and proactively adjusting commercial approaches accordingly. 
7. Collaborate closely with internal departments/teams to ensure the highest product quality and performance in order to fully meet customer expectations. 
8. Initiate and personally follow up on new R&D projects based on market perspectives and customer requirements. 
9. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
10. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
11. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
12. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
13. Ensure accurate (pre-)sales administration, including quotation management, technical support coordination, contract compliance, sales order booking, lead-time and deliverable tracking, communication with support departments, customer payment follow-up, and non-conformity processes.

17. Responsible for visual inspection of slings, ensuring accurate assessment, proper documentation, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Strong commercial acumen with a track record of positive results in previous sales, business development, or project 
management roles. 
• Experience in offshore lifting, mooring, heavy lifting, or similar industries is a strong advantage. 
• Ability to develop and manage multiple accounts, balancing long-term relationship building with short-term revenue generation. 
• Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders. 
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix management organization and collaborate across internal teams to deliver high-quality solutions. 
• Ability to analyze key sales data and translate findings into actionable business strategies. 
• Self-starter, able to work independently with minimal supervision, while also being a team player.

Qualifications and Education
